decree: decret n 2-72-054 du 28 kaada 1391 (15 Jan 1972) portant revalorisation du salaire minimum dans l industrie, le commerce, les professions liberales et l agriculture
notes: Single national hourly rate "pour l ensemble du Maroc"; art. 3 abolishes the wage-zone system (arrete of 28 Feb 1948 as amended). Agricultural cash part: 5 DH/day for men and 4 DH/day for women (smag column left blank because it was sex-differentiated). Retroactive effect (decree dated 15 Jan 1972). Monthly column is a mechanical hourly x 191 computation (post-2004 44-hour week convention); before the Labour Code (in force June 2004) the legal week was 48 h, so it is NOT the legal monthly minimum of the time.
